title: 有馬記念の後に・顔を上げれば

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite not taking the win, Nice Nature is able to look back on the Arima Kinen as a fun experience where she strived with all her might to live up to her fans' expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then tries to ask Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan for the secret to becoming even stronger than she is now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two, pleased by the question, promise to answer this question properly at a later date.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Showing signs of new growth, Nice Nature aims for her next goal—the Takarazuka Kinen.
